title: Block Matching
text: Estimate motion between images or video frames, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Estimate motion between}, {N}, {Search method} sets the block match search, {Block matching criteria}, {Block size [height width]} sets the block size, {Overlap size [r c]} sets the block overlap, {Maximum displacement [r c]} sets the maximum displacement and {Velocity output}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I/I1
ports.summary: Image or video frame scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: I2
ports.summary: Image or video frame scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: V
ports.summary: Velocity components in complex form scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Estimate motion between
params.values: Estimate motion between images or frames Current frame and N-th frame back (default) | Two images

params.name: Search method
params.values: Block match search method Exhaustive (default) | Three-step

params.name: Block matching criteria
params.values: Block matching criteria Mean square error (MSE) (default) | Mean absolute difference (MAD)

params.name: Velocity output
params.values: Velocity output Magnitude-squared (default) | Horizontal and vertical components in complex form
